description: A BGP instance of the router in one VRF: its AS number and router ID, how many equal paths it installs, its BFD timers, the networks it announces and the routes it imports from other VRFs.

asn.description: AS number of the instance. It stays while the BGP document keeps its name; a BGP document of another name replaces the old one, AS number included.

x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the AS number stays " + string(oldSelf) + "; to change it, deliver the config without the BGP document, which ends the router's sessions, and then with the new AS number"

multiplier.description: BFD packets in a row a peer may miss before the router takes it for down and ends the session.

receiveMs.description: Shortest interval in milliseconds at which the router accepts BFD packets of the peers with `bfd`.

transmitMs.description: Shortest interval in milliseconds at which the router sends BFD packets.

gracefulRestart.description: Whether the router keeps a peer's routes while the peer restarts and asks its peers to keep its own.

import.description: Routes the instance takes from the BGP instances of other VRFs, which the kernel installs in this VRF's table with their next hops in the other VRF. Static routes of a VRF's links are not leaked.

policy.description: RoutingPolicy that decides the routes the instance takes from all of `vrfs`; null takes every route.

vrfs.description: VRFs whose BGP instances' routes of the family the instance takes, each once, by the names of their VRF documents or `default`.

ipv4.description: IPv4 routes the instance takes from other VRFs' instances; null takes none.

vrfs.description: VRFs whose BGP instances' routes of the family the instance takes, each once, by the names of their VRF documents or `default`.

ipv6.description: IPv6 routes the instance takes from other VRFs' instances; null takes none.

ebgp.description: Equal paths from external peers the router installs for one prefix at most.

ibgp.description: Equal paths from internal peers the router installs for one prefix at most.

networks.description: Networks the router announces to its peers.

prefix.description: Address range the router announces while its table holds a route to it.
